item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and structures an advisory commission, an internal organizational action without changing substantive legal rights.","evidence":"There is established the President's Commission on the Holocaust."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs appointments and chair designation and invites congressional leaders to designate members; these are staffing actions for an advisory body.","evidence":"The President shall appoint twentyfour members of the Commission"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Commission must later prepare a report, recommendations, and a funding-feasibility study; these are advisory and review functions with no dictated legal consequence.","evidence":"The Commission shall submit a report to the President and the Secretary of the Interior"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Commission is directed to recommend commemorative approaches, an advisory function that does not itself establish a legal right or status.","evidence":"The Commission shall recommend appropriate ways for the nation to commemorate April 28 and 29, 1979"},{"segment_id":"5","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines internal administrative support and delegated functions with a present entitlement of Commission members to travel expenses, which is a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"Members of the Commission shall be entitled to travel expenses"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Commission must submit its final report on a deadline and then terminate; both are internal reporting and organizational provisions.","evidence":"The Commission shall terminate not later than thirty days after submitting its final report."}]}
